reconciled_findings.assessment: Fresh source review confirms status dispatch, selected-root and authority-epoch helpers plus current_identity. Keep analytics bare ticket keys and usage repository-qualified Scope/cache keys distinct. Original proposal already parameterizes member conversion; evidence supports that boundary, not a new separate finding. Approximate shared LOC and all runtime reconciliation clauses remain outside this subset verification.

Three authorized_context sites now verified, including renamed fallback variable in AnalyticsLive. Existing recommendation to own the gate in FinancialDataAccess is supported. Cursor and subscription helpers add evidence, but the claimed roughly 300-line pipeline, debounce precedence, cache epochs and all loader error paths have not been reverified by the duplication pass. Do not mark the entire finding verified from these spans.

RunSummary and CurrentRunOutcomes share reconcile structure but differ in availability: run.valid? is required only by RunSummary. The inherited recommendation explicitly accepts availability/sameness callbacks, so this difference qualifies extraction rather than refuting the finding. Other presenters and health/reason vocabulary claims remain to be rechecked; preserve domain predicates.

Fresh census confirms three TUI safe_call sites and five AIUR_DEBUG readers. RenderState.safe_call already supplies a TUI-local public owner, so creating a generic core/util helper for that operation is unnecessary. Hash, comment-ID, urgent-digest and screen-grab claims are not resolved by these matches. Preserve failure and sampling semantics; avoid bundling unrelated small helpers into one mandatory core package.

Four branch-discovery helpers and their head/ref extraction are verified across both poll batches, including precedence and ordered guesses. Link all exact clusters to this existing finding instead of counting four new opportunities. Overflow, GraphQL normalization and escaping claims still require their own semantic review; the inherited note correctly identifies selecting one overflow policy as a behavior change.

metric_count and member_state_digest implementations/aliases match and source comments require parity. This supports a provider-neutral BuildOrder metrics owner. It does not independently verify the P1 overflow incident, its production prevalence, PlanningSource behavior or every progress branch. Retain this ID/severity as inherited pending the required skeptic check, not validated by the duplicate-body census.

limits: Six selected inherited findings read in full and compared with current candidate assessments. This is partial claim-level corroboration, not final finding deduplication or high-severity skeptic review. Original IDs preserved; no raw findings deleted, reseveritized or promoted.
